_comment: Every App Store localization whose metadata Apple indexes on the United States storefront. Text in these localizations ranks in US search, so each one is another 30-character name, 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field aimed at US searchers. Screenshots are not needed: App Store Connect shows the primary language's screenshots for a localization that has none. Verified 2026-09-10 against aso.dev/metadata/cross-localization (updated 2026-07-10) and AppTweak/Phiture's storefront table; re-check yearly, Apple does not publish this list.
